mentions.name: qApp
mentions.description: A lightweight queue and appointment reservation management system for businesses. Customers join a queue through a simple online form and receive updates via SMS, with no apps or complicated logins required.
mentions.audience: Businesses that need to manage customer queues and appointments.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm currently developing qApp, a lightweight queue and appointment reservation management system for businesses. The idea is to let customers join a queue through a simple online form and receive updates via SMS — no apps, no complicated logins.
